The Justice of Hadhrat Umar Farooq (RA)
The Incident of Hadhrat Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Ubay bin Ka'b (RA)

Hadhrat Sha'bi reports that a dispute arose between Hadhrat Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Ubay bin Ka'b (RA). Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "Appoint someone to decide the matter between us." They then agreed to appoint Hadhrat Zaid bin Thaabit (RA) (to settle the matter) between them. When the two men came to Hadhrat Zaid (RA), he made place at the head side of his bedding saying, "Sit here, O Ameerul Mu'mineen." Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "That is the first wrong you have committed in your decision-making procedure. I shall rather sit with my contestant." The two men then sat in front of Hadhrat Zaid (RA). Hadhrat Ubay (RA) made his claim and Hadhrat Umar (RA) refuted it. Hadhrat Zaid (RA) then said to Hadhrat Ubay (RA), "Absolve the Ameerul Mu'mineen (from taking an oath, which is the next step of the procedure since no witnesses were presented). I would not have asked for this concession for anyone else besides the Ameerul Mu'mineen." However, Hadhrat Umar (RA) still took the oath and then said, "Zaid will be unable to judge unless he treats Umar as a man from the ranks of the common Muslims." [^2]

The narration of Ibn Asaakir states that Hadhrat Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) disputed about the harvesting of a date crop. With tears in his eyes, Hadhrat Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) said, "Is this how it will be under your rule, O Umar?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "Then appoint someone to decide between us." When Hadhrat Ubay (RA) suggested the name of Hadhrat Zaid bin Thaabit (RA), Hadhrat Umar (RA) accepted and the two of them went to him. The rest of the narration is like the one above. [^3]
The Dispute Between Hadhrat Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) Concerning the Expansion of the Masjidun Nabawi

Hadhrat Zaid bin Aslam reports that Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) had a house next to the Masjid of Madinah. Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) to sell the house to him because he intended adding it to the Masjid. However, Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) refused to sell it. When Hadhrat Umar (RA) requested him to give it as a gift, Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) refused this as well. Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "You have no option but to accept one of the two proposals." When Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) still refused, Hadhrat Umar (RA) told him to appoint someone (to decides the matter between them). Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) appointed
Bayhaqi, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.3 Pg.127).
Ibn Asaakir, Sa'eed bin Mansoor and Bayhaqi.
